title: Persistent guided NoC configuration workflow
summary: Built backend policy and GUI state-machine orchestration for guided product-aware interconnect configuration.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2026-07-29. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Created the guided GUI flow for newer NoC tooling.
Implemented Configuration Engine policies and GUI workflow for product-aware parameter constraints, structured compliance results and integration of existing area-reduction functionality.
Implemented versioned flow metadata, read-only editor restrictions, corrupt-state recovery, atomic retirement, checkpoint/save/load coordination and invalidation after mutations.
Implemented a persistent Guided Flow lifecycle with starting, active and retired states, queued policy mutations, project-context checks and atomic metadata replacement.
Connected product-specific guided editing to backend compliance checks for supported constraints, structured violations and persistence/export preflight.

An October 1, 2026 commit separately reports 79 Guided Flow executions, 132 Playwright passes with seven competing-load skips, 105 CE passes with nine missing-fixture skips, 522 Angular passes and two renderer builds; these are historical reports, not newly rerun results.

notes: Integration of existing area-reduction functionality is not ownership of the underlying algorithm; no silicon area or latency percentage is established.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
